displayName: Configure Edge scareware blocker to share URLs of sites detected as potential tech scams with Microsoft Defender SmartScreen (User)
description:
This policy controls whether Microsoft Edge shares URLs of sites that are detected as potential tech scams with Microsoft Defender SmartScreen.

This policy only takes effect if ScarewareBlockerProtectionEnabled is enabled.

If you enable this policy, Microsoft Edge will share URLs of sites detected as potential tech scams with Microsoft Defender SmartScreen.

If you disable or don't configure this policy, Microsoft Edge will not share URLs of sites detected as potential tech scams with Microsoft Defender SmartScreen.
